page.overview:
Who is Nima Cruz?

Nima Cruz was a member of the Tun-Si tribe that used to live on Isla Nublar before InGen forced the entire tribe to leave the island. After her displacement she became a mercenary. She was hired by BioSyn to retrieve Dennis Nedry's Barbasol can from Jurassic Park.

She speaks both Spanish and English fluently, often using them interchangeably in her dialogue.

Nima was born on Isla Nublar as part of the Tun-Si tribe who had lived on the island for thousands of years. She was raised by her father, a spiritual healer.

In 1981, her people were forced to abandon their home after the island was loaned to InGen by the Costa Rican government. InGen also hired mercenaries to force the native populace off the island; among the mercenaries was Oscar Morales. Some of Nima's people tried to stop them, but any resistance was crushed. Nima became distant from her father, who eventually died a broken man, and went on to have a daughter of her own, Atlanta. With no financial support from InGen or the government, Nima and her people were forced to live in extreme poverty.
